meta.tree: Flop: raiser c-bets 33% or 75%, caller raises 60% or all-in, no donk bets. Turn (after a called 33% c-bet, 2 cards): raiser bets 50% or 100%. River (after the main turn bet is called, 1 card): 75% or all-in. Turn and river ranges are the hands that took the line, weighted per hand class. Accuracy 1% of pot.
